name: Keikakuteki Gekokujou ~Damasareta S Jokei Joshi~
original_name: 計画的下剋上 〜騙されたS女系女子〜
source:
A bitchy sadistic type girl is bound up and played with thoroughly.

"It's not that I want a pet. 
It's that I wanna see a strong girl in a painful, embarrassing situation. 
I want to hear the struggle in her voice."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE241531.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个恶毒的虐待狂类型的女孩被捆绑并彻底玩弄。

“我并不是想要一只宠物。
我想看到一个坚强的女孩处于痛苦、尴尬的境地。
我想听到她声音中的挣扎。”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE241531.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
